issue.description:
Child 2 of 4 splitting umbrella beadrs-12b78650. Depends on child 1 (pick disposition note recorded) so the explicit republish captures the final tracker state.

The abort left the git-tracked checkpoint (.beads/checkpoint/current.json, previous.json, forensic.jsonl, objects/*) modified/deleted vs HEAD — residue of the old 17 UU / 6 AA / 9 AD / 2 DU conflict set. The parent's acceptance forbids hand-editing checkpoint JSON: the checkpoint must be republished from the authoritative SQLite store, and the only writer is the bead CLI.

Use the repo build /home/coding/target/debug/bead (the installed ~/.cargo/bin/bead lags this repo).

Acceptance:
- bead sync flush-only exits 0 and reports the checkpoint in sync with beads.db; a second run is a no-op (idempotency check)
- grep across .beads/checkpoint/ (current.json, previous.json, forensic.jsonl, objects/*) finds no conflict markers (<<<<<<<, =======, >>>>>>>)
- No checkpoint JSON hand-edited at any point
- Command output appended to this child's notes before closing
issue.title: Republish the bead-rs checkpoint from SQLite with bead sync flush-only

issue.description:
AGENTS.md defines NEEDLE compatibility by research/specs/needle-cli-contract-v1.md and forbids claiming compatibility without passing the corresponding conformance suite, but no open bead tracks an executable suite for that contract — the existing NEEDLE consumer canary (beadrs-41b9130e) covers only the claim-epoch slice. Derive the assertion list from the spec, implement it as a test lane against a scratch workspace, wire it into bead-rs-ci, and record a passing run in the release gate before any compatibility claim is published.

Priority: P2
Created by: weave strand
issue.title: Build and run the needle-cli-contract-v1 conformance suite as a CI lane
